# Driver Checklist: Speaker-To-Mic Leakage Control

**Purpose**: Validate that capture, driver, recording, and realtime-safety requirements are complete and unambiguous before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-06-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are finalized-package leakage requirements complete for original `mic.wav`, original `incoming.wav`, and optional derived cleaned tracks? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003b.1, Spec §FR-010a.1, Plan §Implementation Approach]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements complete for timeline alignment, duration mismatch, clock drift, missing silence padding, and unknown `t=0` before any package can be called clean? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Spec Edge Cases, Data Model §ThresholdVersion]
- [x] CHK003 Are route metadata requirements complete for input class, output class, volume bucket, mute state, browser target, route changes, `coreaudiod`, and sleep/wake facts without becoming live blockers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-009, Data Model §RecordingRouteMetadata]
- [x] CHK004 Are self-routing rejection requirements defined separately from leakage readiness, so virtual-device self-routing remains prohibited even though live leakage route readiness is out of scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Plan §Implementation Approach]
